operations.name: List File Systems
operations.notes: Lists active filesystems on HNS-enabled accounts with prefix filtering and opaque local continuation tokens. The JSON uses numbers and booleans where Azure uses strings.

operations.name: Create File System
operations.notes: Creates the same container visible to Blob, with x-ms-properties stored as container metadata. Encryption options are unavailable.

operations.name: Get File System Properties
operations.notes: Returns the shared ETag, Last-Modified, the HNS flag, and x-ms-properties. No encryption properties.

operations.name: Set File System Properties
operations.notes: Stores x-ms-properties as the container's metadata with ETag and date conditions.

operations.name: Delete File System
operations.notes: Deletes the shared container immediately. No retention or recreation delay.

operations.name: List Paths
operations.notes: Lists files and directories recursively or one level at a time, optionally scoped to a directory, with owner, group, and permissions, and opaque local continuation tokens in binary name order. upn is accepted but ignored. isDirectory and contentLength are JSON booleans and numbers where Azure uses strings.

operations.name: Create Path
operations.notes: Creates files and directories with implicit parent directories, conditions, x-ms-properties, ACL, permissions, umask, owner and group headers, and a lease at creation. If-None-Match: * on an existing path answers 409 PathAlreadyExists, which is unverified against Azure. Encryption and expiry headers are unsupported.

operations.name: Rename Path
operations.notes: Renames files and directories in legacy and posix modes. A directory rename is one metadata transaction, so a concurrent Blob or DFS listing sees the old tree or the new tree. Source and destination conditions and leases apply; an existing destination answers 409 PathAlreadyExists, unverified against Azure.

operations.name: Append Data
operations.notes: Appends at a position up to 100 MiB per request into staged ranges over immutable extents that Blob and DFS reads do not see until flush. Appending to a missing path creates it, which is unverified against Azure.

operations.name: Flush Data
operations.notes: Commits staged data at a position with close and retainUncommittedData, and sets content headers. A flushed file reads identically through Blob with the same ETag. A flush rewrites the committed bytes plus the staged ranges into a new extent, except a file's first single-append flush, which links the staged extent.

operations.name: Read File
operations.notes: Reads the same committed Blob bytes, with ETag conditions, lease checks, and single byte ranges. No range checksums or date conditions.

operations.name: Get Path Properties
operations.notes: Supports getProperties, getStatus, and getAccessControl. Returns the resource type, ETag, content properties, x-ms-properties, owner, group, permissions, ACL, and lease state. A directory also carries x-ms-meta-hdi_isfolder: true, which Azure's DFS endpoint does not send; AzCopy needs it on path-style endpoints, where Blob calls arrive on the DFS URL (requests with restype or comp go to Blob).

operations.name: Set Path Properties
operations.notes: Update Path with setProperties replaces x-ms-properties and the content headers, with conditions and lease checks.

operations.name: Get Access Control
operations.notes: Returns x-ms-owner, x-ms-group, x-ms-permissions, and x-ms-acl for files and directories; upn is accepted but ignored.

operations.name: Set Access Control
operations.notes: Sets owner, group, permissions, or ACL on a path. Shared Key and account SAS bypass ACL checks as Azure does; bearer tokens are checked against owner, group, and ACL with the token's oid, and carry no group membership.

operations.name: Set Access Control Recursive
operations.notes: Sets, modifies, or removes ACL entries across a subtree in bounded batches with a stable continuation token and the documented counters (directoriesSuccessful, filesSuccessful, failureCount, failedEntries). Ownership is checked per entry; each descendant's execute bit is not.

operations.name: Lease Path
operations.notes: Acquire, renew, release, break, and change over the shared Blob lease state machine.

operations.name: Delete Path
operations.notes: Deletes files, empty directories, and with recursive=true whole subtrees in one transaction, paged by continuation; non-empty directories without recursive answer DirectoryNotEmpty. Answers 200, which is unverified against Azure. Staged extents of a deleted file are reclaimed at the next start.
